subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen new GitHub Action commit pins in credentialed, release, security-scanning, and automation workflows after a refreshed green run?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but accepting new third-party action code in secret-bearing workflows is a repository trust-boundary decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Accept after refreshed verification
options.body: Verify the official release provenance for the updated action commits, refresh onto current `main`, and merge only after the affected CI gate is green.

options.title: Pause the batch update
options.body: Leave the existing pinned revisions in place until workflow/security owners can review the supplied action releases and CI failures.

recommendation.title: Accept after refreshed verification
recommendation.body: Verify the official release provenance for the updated action commits, refresh onto current `main`, and merge only after the affected CI gate is green.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only explicit security-routing actor captured in the provided PR context; no human workflow owner could be traced from the read-only inspection available here.
